description: Emperor Time dogma hooks. Short. They bite.

hooks.prompt: Emperor Time dogma: purpose is autonomous DONE, not token theater. Define DONE in .emperor/tasks/<id>/DONE.md. Prove it with scripts/emperor done (Unix) or pwsh -File scripts/emperor.ps1 done (Windows). No cmd.exe shim. No easy path. Swarm-emulate if the host has no swarm. Memory is CONJECTURE.

hooks.command: last=''; if [ -d .emperor/tasks ]; then last=$(ls -1d .emperor/tasks/* 2>/dev/null | tail -n1); fi; if [ -n "$last" ] && [ -f "$last/DONE.md" ]; then if command -v pwsh >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f scripts/emperor.ps1 ]; then pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/emperor.ps1 done "$last" || echo '[Emperor Time] STOP: DONE probes failed'; elif [ -f scripts/emperor ]; then bash scripts/emperor done "$last" || echo '[Emperor Time] STOP: DONE probes failed'; else bash scripts/done.sh "$last" || echo '[Emperor Time] STOP: DONE probes failed'; fi; elif [ -d .emperor/tasks ]; then echo '[Emperor Time] STOP: no DONE.md — define DONE before claiming it.'; fi
